text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to my office when two
students
emerge from a nearby
classroom in an argument.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh! Leave me alone already! I can't
focus on
the race with you nagging me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's cleaning time right now, so just
record your
little motorcycle race and
watch it later!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's the point in watching if it's not
even live?!
You just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't get it? I don't want to hear that from someone who doesn't even "get" why she should prioritize her assigned tasks!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! You... you're such a pain!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Why don't you just go find someone who actually wants to clean?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Stop shirking your responsibilities! Hey,
come
back here! Ugh... I swear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I later spot Vodka hanging out behind
the school,
watching a heated
motorcycle race on her phone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as intense as the race sounds, Vodka
doesn't
look like she's enjoying herself
at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! What's her problem?! This
sucks... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you were in the hallway earlier, huh?
Sorry
you had to see that.
choice_data_list: なんだか楽しくなさそうだな
なんだか楽しくなさそうだね
choice_data_list_en: You don't look like you're having much fun.
You don't seem to be having much fun.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I can't stop thinking about what Scarlet
said.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't get it? I don't want to hear that from someone who doesn't even "get" why she should prioritize her assigned tasks!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She's right... Skipping out on my
responsibilities
like that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That was so uncool! Damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: She must be so done with me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Guess it's that or bust!
choice_data_list: 反省の態度を見せよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's show them you've learned your lesson!
All you have to do is apologize sincerely.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The whole thing was my bad, and I
shouldn't have
been that rude to her! I'm
never gonna pull such a
lame stunt
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that very moment...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, fine. Get outta the way, will you?
I got
trash to throw out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet?! Did you hear what I was
saying?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Well, you were practically
yelling. So, you
were rude to a particular
someone?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And to whom exactly were you rude this time?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Don't give me that! Just hand over
that
garbage bag! I'll help clean!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm... So who were you talking about
again?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C-come on, drop it already! You know
who!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I don't have the slightest idea. I'm
afraid I
won't "get it" until you say it
loud and clear for
me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! I'm not gonna say it! You can't make me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I can do that... Nah, yeah. I've got no choice but to apologize, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I won't run away! I'll apologize to her
and there'll
be no ifs, ands, or buts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that very moment...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Have you been here this whole time?
And what's
all this about apologizing to
someone?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet! Perfect timing! U-um...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I ditched cleaning duty! I was
being
selfish, and...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's fine. Just do better from now on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like you have to tell me! I'll make the
place so
clean you'll be able to see your
face on every
surface!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to get to work! You take
care of
wiping things down, and I'll
sweep the place.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Awfully bossy considering you were
neglecting
your duties not five minutes
ago...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what about that race you were
watching? Is
it over already?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's still going on, but now's not the
time to
be watching it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're sounding very serious... Are
you
feeling all right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine! Just trying to take
responsibility
here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've got no business admiring cool stuff
while
acting majorly uncool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. So nothing's really changed,
then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You just take a backseat and leave it all
to me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Take this! And this, and this, and this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka swings the broom about wildly,
whipping
up whirlwinds of dust.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Cough! Hack! Stop! Hey, I said quit it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What are you playing at?! Did you come
back just
to make a mess?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All we gotta do is open the windows and
let the
dust blow out! Am I a genius or
what?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's the least intelligent idea I've ever
heard,
and the dust isn't even going
outside! Ugh, you're
just so—

text_block_list.name: Vodka and Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No we don't!
choice_data_list_en: You two really get along well, huh.
You two really get along well, don't you.
